\begin{quote}
\textbf{Prove Proposition 4.1:} If the game \(\Gamma = \langle N, \{S_i\}_{i=1}^{n}, \{v_i\}_{i=1}^{n} \rangle\) has a strictly dominant strategy equilibrium \(s^D\), then \(s^D\) is the unique dominant strategy equilibrium.
\end{quote}
